DeR 15 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this"Agreement"), made as of July 17, 2013,by and between88Richardson LLC,having an address at 505 Flushing Avenue,Suite 1D, at 316 Douglass Street, 2nd Floor, Brooklyn,NewYork 11217 ("Purchaser"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, the Seller is the owner in fee title of a parcel of land in Brooklyn, New York, designated as Block 2732, Lot 12 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Kings County, and more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part hereof (saidland and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as the “Seller Land", together with any building or improvements placed thereon, including the Seller Project (as defined below), hereinafter referred to as, the “Seller Building” and, the Seller Land and the Seller Building, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as the "Seller Property"); and WHEREAS,Purchaser is the owner of fee title in certain land,in Brooklyn, New York designated as Block 2732, Lot 30 on the Tax Map of the City of New York,Kings County, and more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as the “Purchaser Land", together with any.building or improvements placed thereon,including the Purchaser Project (as defined below),hereinafter referred to as, the “Purchaser Building" and, the Purchaser Land and the Purchaser Building. togetherwith anyfuture additions,alterations andreplacements thereof beinghereinafterreferred to as the “Purchaser Property"); the Seller Land and the Purchaser Land are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the "Parcels" and each individually as a"Parcel"); and WHEREAS,theSeller intends to construct on theSeller Land a newbuilding of approximately 186,376 square feet in the aggregate, which shall contain approximately one hundred eighty- eight (188) apartment units and ground floor parking(the “Seller Project"); and WHEREAS,the Purchaser intends to construct on the Purchaser Land a new building of approximately 45,129 square feet in the aggregate, which shall contain approximately forty- WHEREAS,Purchaser and Seller desires to utilize the procedure available under the present Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (as may be amended, the “Zoning Resolution") for declaring the Purchaser Land and the Seller Land a single zoning lot for the purpose of causing the Seller Project and the Purchaser Project to comply with the limitations contained in the Zoning Resolution. NOW THEREFORE,in considerationof Ten Dollars($10.00)and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows: 1

ARTICLEI DECLARATIONOFRESTRICTIONS Section_1.1 The parties hereto are, simultaneously herewith, executing and delivering a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions,as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (the “Declaration"), a copy of the Declaration is annexed hereto as Exhibit B and made a part hereof,which seeks to effectuate the intentions of the parties by creating a single zoning lot (herein called the "Single Zoning Lot") comprising both the Seller Land and the Purchaser Land. ARTICLEII FLOORAREADEVELOPMENTRIGHTS Section 2.1 The Purchaser Property shall be allocated thirty-eight thousand ninety-three (38,093) square feet of Floor Area Development Rights (as such term is defined in Section 2.3 below) available totheSingleZoningLot for residential useunder the Zoning Resolution(the "Purchaser Amount"),which Purchaser Amount of Floor Area Development Rights shall be utilized to permit the Purchaser toconstruct the Purchaser Project incompliance with the limitations and restrictions contained in the Zoning Resolution.The Seller Property shall be allocated the balance of Floor Area Development Rights (as such term is defined in Section 2.3 below) available to the Single Zoning Lot under the Zoning Resolution (the “Seller Amount"), includingFloor AreaDevelopmentRights attributableto the upzoning of theSingleZoningLot (subject to the provisions of Section 2.4 below), which Seller Amount of Floor Area DevelopmentRightsshallbeutilizedtopermit theSeller toconstruct theSellerProjectin compliance with the limitations and restrictions contained in the Zoning Resolution. Section2.2ThePurchasershallbeentitledandisauthorizedtousethePurchaserAmountof FloorAreaDevelopmentRights(assuchterm is definedinSection 2.3below)which ariseoutof or are appurtenant to theSingleZoningLot and theSeller shall be entitled to and is authorized to use theSeller Amount of FloorArea Development Rights (as such term is defined in Section 2.3 Section 2.3 As used in this Agreement the term“Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights,as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoninglot by erecting thereon a structure or structures and the term "floor area”' shall have the same meaning as ascribed to it in the Zoning Resolution. Section 2.4 If there is a casualty loss that results in the destruction of both the Purchaser Building and the Seller Building and, due to an intervening downzoning of the Single Zoning Lot, there areinsufficient Floor AreaDevelopment Rights then available torebuildboththePurchaser Building and theSellerBuilding to their original size,thenboth thePurchaserAmount and Seller Amount will be reduced by a percentage which is equal to the percentage reduction in the overall Floor Area Development Rights available to theSingle ZoningLot.
